parsed.e_t: The current page is the search results page for 'Anker charger' on One Stop Market, showing page 1 of results (items 1-12 of 2527 total). The sort order is still 'Relevance' (selected=true in the DOM sorter select element). The sort dropdown (id='sorter') is rendered as a native HTML select element with options: Product Name (value='name'), Price (value='price'), and Relevance (value='relevance', selected). The page displays 12 product listings including Anker chargers and cables. Prices visible on this page range from $8.99 to $59.99. Pagination shows links to pages 2-5 and a Next link.
C: The sort dropdown is a native HTML select element; clicking on ARIA combobox menuitem nodes may not trigger the sort change — a direct select option change or URL parameter approach may be needed
Search results include non-charger items (cables, etc.) mixed in with actual chargers, so filtering or careful identification is needed

F_t.action: Clicked menuitem 'Price' [8809] to sort by price
F_t.cause: The sort control is a native HTML <select> element in the DOM (id='sorter'), not an ARIA combobox with clickable menuitems. Clicking the ARIA menuitem representation did not change the selected option — the DOM still shows 'relevance' as selected after the action.

F_t.action: Clicked menuitem 'Price' [8809] again to sort by price
F_t.cause: Same as step 5 — the underlying DOM element is a native <select>, and the ARIA menuitem click did not change the sort order. DOM confirms 'relevance' remains selected.

F_t.action: Clicked combobox 'Sort By' [8562] to open dropdown
F_t.cause: Opening the dropdown alone does not change the sort; this was a preparatory step. No sort change occurred.

Again failed to change sort order. DOM at step 8 observation still shows 'Relevance' selected=True and 'Price' selected=False, confirming the native select was not changed by clicking the ARIA menuitem.
Preparatory action only; sort order remains unchanged per DOM evidence showing relevance still selected.

K_t: The search query 'Anker charger' returns 2527 total results on One Stop Market

Page 1 Anker charger prices observed: $8.99 (313 Wireless Charger Pad), $13.99 (PowerPort 2), $14.99 (cables - not chargers), $19.49 (313 Wireless Charger Stand), $29.99 (711 Charger, PowerPort Atom, PowerPort PD 2, PowerPort 5), $35.99 (521 Charger Nano Pro), $59.99 (PowerCore Speed 20000)

The sort control is a native HTML <select> element with id='sorter' and data-role='sorter'; to sort by price, the agent should interact with the native select or navigate via URL parameter (e.g., ?product_list_order=price)
The URL for price-sorted results would be: http://172.185.52.29:7770/catalogsearch/result/index/?q=Anker+charger&product_list_order=price
Non-charger items (cables) appear in search results and should be excluded when listing charger names

Page 2 chargers included prices of $15.99, $19.99, $23.99, $25.99 — extending the observed range but not necessarily the full range across all 2527 results
